title: Privacy Policy
lead: How OCMONO Avenues Pvt Ltd collects, uses, and protects information when you use our websites, products, and services.

sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: OCMONO Avenues Pvt Ltd (“OCMONO”, “we”, “us”) operates ocmono.com and related product sites. We provide performance marketing services and SaaS products including ClinicPro, MenuBip, and related platforms.
Registered office: Shop No: 36, R4/A, Vaishnavi Society, Nesco Colony, W. E. Highway, Goregaon East, Mumbai 400063, Maharashtra, India.

sections.heading: Information we collect
paragraphs: We collect information you provide directly and information generated when you use our sites or products.
bullets: Contact details such as name, email, phone, company, and message content from forms or strategy-call bookings
Product demo, waitlist, and newsletter subscription details
Account and billing information when you use our SaaS products (handled under each product’s terms)
Usage data such as pages visited, device/browser type, approximate location, and referral source
Cookies and similar technologies for analytics, preferences, and marketing measurement

sections.heading: How we use information
bullets: Respond to enquiries and schedule demos or strategy calls
Provide, improve, and support our websites, campaigns, and SaaS products
Send product or growth updates you opted into (you can unsubscribe anytime)
Measure performance of marketing and site experience
Meet legal, security, and fraud-prevention obligations

sections.heading: Sharing
paragraphs: We do not sell your personal information. We may share data with trusted processors who help us run email, hosting, analytics, payments, or advertising — under contracts that require appropriate protection. We may also disclose information when required by law or to protect rights, safety, and our services.

sections.heading: Retention & security
paragraphs: We keep information only as long as needed for the purposes above, including legal and accounting requirements. We apply reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect data; no method of transmission or storage is completely secure.

sections.heading: Your choices
paragraphs: You may request access, correction, or deletion of personal information we hold about you, subject to applicable law. Contact contact@ocmono.com. You can also opt out of marketing emails via the unsubscribe link in those messages.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: For privacy questions: contact@ocmono.com · +91 8850 533614 · Goregaon East, Mumbai.
